name: coir-copse-demo-ci
description: CI gate: coir (static ClickEvent map) × copse (live reachability) over the pre-built coir-copse-demo game. No Cocos editor in the loop — it runs against ../build/web-mobile.

scripts.check: npm run rows && npm run suite && npm run gate && npm run selftest

comment: Zero runtime deps. The flow suite IS copse's own runner: `copse run <dir> --junit`.
COIR_CLI / COPSE_CLI env vars point at the two tools (default: sibling repos).
Local runs use --headed on purpose: headless Chrome renders Cocos via SwiftShader
(software WebGL) and cooks the machine. CI is headless — ephemeral, heat irrelevant.
